declarations.comment: The second paragraph opens with 'This is a compatibility annotation ...' — a mild self-reference. The rule targets descriptions that begin with 'This class/trait/object/method', so this does not breach it strictly (the first sentence leads with 'Marks'), but the 'This is ...' opener is still self-referential. A third-person alternative such as 'Acts as a compatibility annotation ...' or 'A compatibility annotation that only records ...' would be more consistent with the voice of the first sentence.
